svg.aria-label: Five-step population-baseline pipeline left to right: individuals, sequence, align, joint calling, structure; below it a two-column contrast with three rows, conventional population genetics on the left (a few marker loci, per-locus assays, F-ST from a handful of markers) against population genomics on the right (every genome-wide variant, one shared variant set and standard pipeline, genome-wide structure that localises to chromosomes)
svg.title: Phase 2: stock-ID baselines built on the references
svg.text: Stock-ID baselines, built on the references
Phase 2 turns Phase-1 references into population baselines for fisheries stock identification —
shared pipelines, a common reference, a common variant set.
